_comment: Material demand for IoA 3D assets. Colours are the ratified faction palettes from docs/game-design/FACTION_IDENTITY.md; hex values are the pipeline's working swatches and may be tuned. 'derive' maps are generated locally from albedo (tools/pbr/derive_maps.py) - never asked from an image model.

sheet.note: one generation yields 4 croppable tiles; quadrants are separated by a 24px neutral gutter
